name: Layered Landscape Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Long, evolving landscapes for Layered Landscape in eleven styles: Ambient, Dark Ambient, Cinematic, Meditation, Sci-Fi, Nature, Space, Drone, Lo-fi, Minimal and Industrial. Each tune is a complete landscape: start the landscape (or the transport) to hear it. Some tunes carry a slow pattern on one layer and need the transport clock; four tunes (Cloud Keys, Played Strings Bed, Playable Stars, Soft Keys) put one layer in notes mode so you can play it from a keyboard.
